findings.finding: The primary123 IT rows are completely manually instantiated, but the artifacts do not provide executable state transitions/typed record schemas. Bookkeeping verification does not establish a grammar/parser PASS.

CHCTHDY individual effect is pending install criterion at D; LCHEDY provides closed criterion. Neither individual effect states the installation completion, yet P5_12 checkpoint says D initially closed. G05 licenses delayed governing operation execution, so no unpriced action or definite contradiction is proven; the completed effect is supplied by the manual stage rather than an explicit per-group discharge.

G04 requires carrier-empty and no selected portion for new allocation. QODY supplies emptyControlV/current portion none manually, and the next QOKY allocates p4. No replayable carrier-content state or emptying transition is supplied after the earlier held p0. Treat empty-control context as the authored premise; do not claim independently verified empty(V), or invent exclusivity/unloading rules to turn this into a contradiction.

SHEY is WaitingOperator yet its instance includes positive uC4 under A10; checkpoint calls this positive reference observation. The output comes from the paid open-Kref signal assumption and manually chosen P5_09 template, not an additional written CHEOL/readout. It is not independent observed target evidence or a free confirmed meaning.

Raw S@221;ROLDAL remains UNKNOWN with explicit missing_dependency in TSV and connected_manual_account=false, but coverage.first_gap_or_dependency is null. This omits the known gap from that coverage field; it does not alter source conservation or repair the unknown.

Paid [?:s]CHEOL and OCHEOL negative-readout entries remain blocked by alternate TECHEDY missing F4; paid S and G14 S+OKEEDY have no consumed instance behind earlier barriers. Their declaration is not an alternate-reader success.

The Component-to-ProcedureSpec type failure is conditional on B-authored signatures. An attached-procedure/activation interpretation changes the grammar and is not forbidden by independent formal evidence. Author-specific types cannot select the meaning.
